Beyer Blinder Belle, an award-winning architecture firm with offices in New York City, Boston, Washington, D.C., and Miami, seeks a highly motivated Junior Designer to join its Boston office. This team works with institutional and civic clients in the Northeast in all project stages, from programming and design to construction.
Along with the skills and experience listed below, our ideal candidate is excited about invigorating high-profile historic buildings through architectural design, brings a strong design sensibility with technical grounding, and actively seeks to develop innovative design concepts and work collaboratively to solve problems.
In addition to working locally with a tight-knit group of architects at many stages of career development, new hires will collaborate virtually with BBB design professionals in the New York, Miami, and Washington, D.C., offices. All BBB employees, including new hires, are eligible to participate in staff initiatives that enhance professional skills, foster connections outside the realm of project work, and promote the values of environmental and social well-being.

Compensation
BBB offers fair and equitable pay. A reasonable estimate of the base salary range for this role is $63,000-$72,000, with variations based on experience, education, achievements, and business needs. Employees may also receive an annual performance-based bonus and salary increase.
Recruitment Process Our hiring process includes an initial application review, followed by one or more interviews with members of the hiring team. Final selections are based on job-related qualifications, alignment with the posted requirements, and business needs. Candidates will receive updates as they move through the process.
As an equal-opportunity employer, BBB is committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workforce where everyone is valued and respected.
In line with our commitment to providing equal opportunities to all candidates, we want to ensure that the interview process is accessible to everyone. If you require any accommodations to facilitate your participation in the interview, please email [email protected] to discuss any accommodations or support you may require. Your request will be handled with the utmost confidentiality and respect. We appreciate your interest in pursuing a career with Beyer Blinder Belle.
